errors.text_span: В долния ляв ъгъл има легенда
errors.evidence: The legend is located on the right side of the chart, not in the bottom left corner.

errors.text_span: Всички сектори са обозначени с процентните си стойности директно вътре в тях.
errors.evidence: This sentence claims that all sectors are labeled with their percentage values, but omits that the absolute values (58, 4, 4, 10) are also labeled within each sector.

errors.text_span: а останалите три са разположени отдясно на него
errors.evidence: This phrase incorrectly states that the three smaller sectors are located to the right of the largest sector ('растеж'). In reality, only the 'пик' sector (orange) is to the right; the 'рецесия' sector (yellow) is to the top-left, and the 'депресия' sector (blue) is at the top.
